def need(value, message):

def path(value):

def read(value):
    value = path(value)
    data = value.read_bytes()
    sha = hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    need(value not in SEEN or SEEN[value] == sha, "Evidence changed: " + str(value))
    SEEN[value] = sha
    return data


def sha(value):
    read(value)
    return SEEN[path(value)]


def text(value):
    data = read(value)
    return data.decode("utf-16" if data.startswith((b"\xff\xfe", b"\xfe\xff")) else "utf-8-sig")


def load(value):

def rel(value):
    value = path(value)
    return value.relative_to(REPO).as_posix() if value.is_relative_to(REPO) else str(value)


def portable(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {rel(k) if Path(k).is_absolute() else k: portable(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [portable(v) for v in value]
    return rel(value) if isinstance(value, str) and Path(value).is_absolute() else value


def identity(value, include=False):
    result = {"path": rel(value), "sha256": sha(value)}

def source(directory, expected, revision=None):
    actual = {p.name: sha(p) for p in directory.glob("*.e")}
    need(actual == expected, "Source byte hashes differ: " + str(directory))
    verification = {}
    if revision:
        for name, digest in actual.items():

            current = read(directory / name)
            need(blob.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n") == current.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n"),
                 "Source content differs from claimed commit: " + name)
            verification[name] = {"snapshot_sha256": digest, "git_blob_sha256": hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),
                                  "relation": "byte-identical" if blob == current else "CRLF/LF differences only"}
    return verification

def publish(outputs):
    staged, published = [], []
    try:
        for destination, payload in outputs:
            if destination.exists():
                need(destination.read_bytes() == payload, "Preserving existing different evidence: " + str(destination))
                continue
            descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".pubmed-position-", dir=destination.parent)
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
                stream.write(payload)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            staged.append((Path(temporary), destination, hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()))
        for temporary, destination, digest in staged:
            need(not destination.exists(), "Publication target appeared concurrently")
            temporary.replace(destination)
            published.append((destination, digest))
    except BaseException:
        for destination, digest in reversed(published):
            if destination.exists() and hashlib.sha256(destination.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest:
                destination.unlink()
        raise
    finally:
        for temporary, _, _ in staged:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def static_context(role):
    """Capture code and static call sites without interpreting them as costs."""
    code = executable(role).parent
    marker = "/* {XP_PARSER}.parse_character_data */"
    chosen = next((p for p in sorted(code.glob("C*/xp*.c")) if marker in text(p)), None)
    need(chosen is not None, "Generated parser C missing: " + role)
    value = text(chosen)
    archive = chosen.parent / ("Cobj" + chosen.parent.name[1:] + ".lib")
    names = ["parse_character_data", "parse_character_data_no_events", "parse_character_data_prefix",
             "note_position", "advance_position_to", "retreat_position_to", "bounded_position_index",
             "is_incomplete_utf8_sequence_at"]
    features = {}
    for name in names:
        tag = "/* {XP_PARSER}." + name + " */"
        if tag not in value:
            features[name] = {"present_in_configuration": False}
            continue
        tail = value[value.index(tag):]
        end = tail.find("\n/* {", len(tag))
        body = tail[:end] if end >= 0 else tail
        match = re.search(r"\b(F\d+_\d+)\s*\(", body)
        features[name] = {"present_in_configuration": True, "c_symbol": match.group(1),
                          "generated_c": body}
    tool = Path("C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft Visual Studio/2022/BuildTools/VC/Tools/MSVC/14.44.35207/bin/HostX64/x64/dumpbin.exe")
    result = {"parser_c": identity(chosen), "object_archive": identity(archive), "features": features,
              "scope": "Generated C and static COFF call sites only. Static sites are not measured invocation counts; "
                       "a missing direct call may reflect inlining or an unreachable path. GC-root frame setup is not "
                       "evidence of per-call heap allocation. Routine profiles separately record measured counts."}
    if tool.is_file():
        command = [str(tool), "/disasm:nobytes", str(archive)]
        assembly = subprocess.check_output(command).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        result["tool_command"] = portable(command)
        for item in features.values():
            if not item["present_in_configuration"]:
                continue
            match = re.search(r"(?m)^" + item["c_symbol"] + r":\s*$", assembly)
            if not match:
                item["coff_symbol_found"] = False
                continue
            tail = assembly[match.end():]
            next_symbol = re.search(r"(?m)^\S[^\n]*:\s*$", tail)
            body = tail[:next_symbol.start()] if next_symbol else tail
            item["coff_symbol_found"] = True
            item["coff_direct_and_indirect_call_sites"] = [line.strip() for line in body.splitlines() if re.search(r"\bcall\b", line)]
            item["coff_entry_excerpt"] = "\n".join(body.splitlines()[:24])
        result["address_scope"] = "Offsets reported for this COFF archive member, not final executable image RVAs"
    else:
        result["coff_status"] = "Configured read-only disassembler unavailable; generated C retained"
    makefile = text(code / "Makefile")
    result["makefile"] = identity(code / "Makefile")
    result["generated_build_flags"] = {key: match.group(1) for key in ["CC", "CFLAGS", "LDFLAGS", "CCLDFLAGS", "EIFLIB"]
                                       if (match := re.search(r"(?m)^" + key + r"\s*=\s*(.*)$", makefile))}
    return result

def capturing_run(*args, **kwargs):

                                "stdout": completed.stdout or b"",
                                "stderr": completed.stderr or b""}
        return completed
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        OBSERVATIONS.process = {"returncode": None, "stdout": error.stdout or b"",
                                "stderr": error.stderr or b"", "timeout": True}
        raise
    except OSError as error:

                                "launch_error": str(error)}

def dump(path, data):

def executables(candidate, build):

def observe(case, build, role, executable, timeout, work, known):

    row = W3C.run_case(case, role + "-" + build, executable, timeout, work)
    process = OBSERVATIONS.process
    entry = known.get((build, case.id))
    category = ""
    if row.status in {"failed", "error"}:
        category = (entry["category"] if entry and entry["status"] == row.status
                    else W3C.observed_category(row))
    result = asdict(row)
    result.update(returncode=process["returncode"], category=category,
                  listed_baseline_failure=bool(entry and entry["status"] == row.status),
                  stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(process["stdout"]).hexdigest(),
                  stderr_sha256=hashlib.sha256(process["stderr"]).hexdigest(),
                  stdout=process["stdout"].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                  stderr=process["stderr"].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"),
                  stdout_hex=process["stdout"].hex(), stderr_hex=process["stderr"].hex())
    return result


def fingerprint(row):
    return tuple(row[key] for key in ("actual", "status", "category", "returncode"))


def compare_one(case, dataset, build, paths, timeout, work, known):
    # Each case and engine has its own crash-output directory, including in parallel runs.
    case_work = work / hashlib.sha256((dataset + case.id).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:20]
    case_work.mkdir()
    observed = {}
    for role, executable in paths.items():
        role_work = case_work / role
        role_work.mkdir()
        observed[role] = observe(case, build, role, executable, timeout, role_work, known)
    baseline, candidate = observed["baseline"], observed["candidate"]
    outcome_match = fingerprint(baseline) == fingerprint(candidate)
    stdout_match = baseline["stdout_hex"] == candidate["stdout_hex"]
    return {"dataset": dataset, "build": build, "case_id": case.id, "path": str(case.path),
            "outcome_match": outcome_match, "stdout_match": stdout_match,
            "match": outcome_match and (dataset != "directed" or stdout_match), **observed}

    if args.scope == "prepare":

    known = W3C.load_known_failures(ROOT / "benchmarks/w3c-known-failures.tsv")
    all_results, summaries = [], []

                                                                         args.timeout, Path(work_name), known), cases))
                    counts = Counter(row["baseline"]["status"] for row in results)
                    skipped = counts["skipped"]
                    differences = [row for row in results if not row["match"]]
                    summary = {"build": build, "dataset": dataset, "total": len(results),

                               "all_case_matches": sum(row["match"] for row in results), "differences": len(differences),

                    all_results.extend(results)

                    dump(output / "summary.json", {"candidate": args.candidate, "profile": W3C.PROFILE,

    finally:

		local
			l_backend: DC_BACKEND
			i: INTEGER
			l_ok: BOOLEAN
		do
			create l_backend.make (False)
			from i := 0; l_ok := True until i = a_iterations or not l_ok loop
				l_ok := l_backend.parse (a_document)

			end
